notes.en: Static content review only. SKILL.md, bundled scripts (python3 stdlib generate_art.py and the node prng_parity.js parity check), inlined core JS and license notices reviewed against the manifest: declared capabilities execution.remote/workspace.read/workspace.write and required tool exec.shell match shipped content; no python dependencies declared and none imported; the HTML artifact is fully self-contained with zero CDN/external requests and no network; app-surface preview uses the existing localService/browser grants. No self-granted trust, no unlisted-skill fetch, no install-time privilege. Guest execution remains UNPROVEN (Main-owned); this is not runtime qualification or App acceptance.
